div.head: I Atr 1.10
div.ab: ⁊ hæbbe ælc hlaford his hiredmen on his agenon borge.
⁊ hæbbe ælc hlaford (his) hiredmen on his agenon borge.
Et habeat omnis dominus familiam suam in plegio suo.
⁊ hæbbe ælc hlaford his hiredmen on his agenon borge.
And every lord shall be personally [responsible as] surety for the men of his own household.
Und jeder Herr halte seine Hausleute unter seiner eigenen Verbürgung.
And let every lord keep his household men under his own surety.
div.note: Clause number corrected from ‘1.1’ to ‘1.10’ (it had been stored as a number, which dropped the final zero). Liebermann compares III As 7.
